notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.3.0.19
notes.content:
[quote]We have today released a new update to address a number of issues that have been brought to our attention, you can find the full changelog below[/quote]

[h3]General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The water texture in the bathtub in the Mayor's house now displays correctly when "RTX Shadows" setting is ON.
[*] The problem of random inventory items spawning and floating inside the cage after the Attic Cage cutscene has been corrected.
[*] The issue where the first item picked in the attic cage was lost after performing 'Load Last Save' has been resolved.
[*] Players can now successfully skip cutscenes by holding the skip button at the start of any cutscene.
[*] The rendering issue with wooden planks on the ground near the Sawmill has been fixed, eliminating black lines when moving back & forth.
[*] The lift jitter during ascend/descend animations after interacting with the Lift Lever in the Church has been stabilized.
[*] The issue with the opened camera crate closing automatically and becoming unopenable when the player stands behind it with a Police NPC in front has been fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Late Fees Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The issue preventing the opening of the door from the basement in the Late Fees DLC has been resolved.
[*] The missing background music after the player is caught by the NPC in the 'Late Fees' has been restored.
[*] The spade book now remains accessible and does not respawn on the fountain after performing Load Last Save and then getting caught by the librarian.
[/list]
[h3]Back to School Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The camera rotation issue after accessing the telescope in science class has been fixed.
[*] The random crashes occurring when the player roams around the school after picking the flag pole key in 'Back to School' DLC have been addressed.
[*] The issue with delayed texture loading before the start of the School Intro cutscene has been rectified.
[*] The camera obstruction by the Van during the End cutscene at School has been fixed.
[*] The Janitor now consistently maintains interest in the player and will catch them when trying prompted to.
[/list]

notes.content:

Hey Hey, neighbors! 

Patch 9, Hotfix 4 has arrived for Hello Neighbor 2 on Steam bringing a ton of fixes, improvements and other goodies to make your stay in Raven Brooks even more enjoyable!

Check out what's new below...
[hr][/hr]
[b]Steam Hotfix 3, version v1.3.0.13[/b]

[h3][b]What’s new:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] A familiar face makes the news... Time to get exploring.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lIrPmV0.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IbfPzty.gif[/img]

[h3]Improvements & bug fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] No more tiptoeing through puddles and leaves without making a sound
[*] Mr. Petesron has slowed down in the final boss fight
[*] Textures no longer flicker throughout the gameplay when 'RTX Reflection' is set to ON
[*] Neighbor no longer gets stuck when searching for Qunetin after he hides under the stairs in the Museum
[*] No more electrical wires hanging in the air near the Otto’s house
[*] Cop no longer tries to look for Quentin under a non-interactive table 
[*] Move freely: A/D movement is no longer blocked after using PortableDisplay before the ladder
[*] Objects no longer defy gravity in the barn
[*] Nielsen can now navigate around cupboard doors
[*] The framed photo piece above the shelf in the Neighbor’s house is firmly grounded now
[*] Be all “ears”: some sound effects have been tuned up
[*] Crane and Generator at the Sawmill have got some improvements and a touch of artistry
[*] Added alert indication when the Guest gets an alert or chases you in the Forest
[*] Wooden logs now move along with the sawmill belt when pulling the lever after placing wooden logs on a belt and selecting 'Load Last Save' 
[*] Raven Brooks Forest got a visual makeover 
[*] Fixed the camera moving into the capsule while running backward
[*] The Guest can no longer stop the siege
[*] The final cutscene in the forest got some fixes
[*] The barrel now falls upon throwing stones over it on loading the last save after placing it on the pressure plate
[*] The curtain holder in the Bakery on the second floor is now the right length
[*] Running speed is no longer reduced after the Nielsen catches you for the second time
[*] Street lights now render properly with "RTX Shadows" turned on. Shine bright!
[*] Door bolt improvements are in
[*] Boards nailed to the elevator no longer hang in the air after loading the save
[*] Guest is no longer switching and turning before entering the generator room
[*] Grass and tombstones at the cemetery have been fixed
[*] Purr-fect Achievements: the Cat and Dog Lover achievements have shed their quirks and now unlock like clockwork 🐾
[*] Adjusted the brightness of the new light on the main map
[*] Holding animations for the barrel have been fixed
[*] The light pole is back on solid ground
[*] Quentin can no longer climb through closed log spawner gates
[*] Relaunching the game won't prevent you from turning on the mine cart if boards were nailed to it before
[*] Once the church bell falls, it stays fallen
[*] Enlarged the hitbox on the log spawner lever
[*] Wooden planks on the trolley persist after selecting 'Load Last Save' in the Forest
[*] Fixed the inability to interact with the bookshelf door lever in the Neighbor’s house after loading the save
[*] Wooden planks in the inventory no longer disappear mysteriously after selecting Load last save in Forest
[*] No more self-performing pianos in the Mayor’s house when he chases Quentin
[*] Restored the sounds of footsteps on the carpet in the Neighbor's house
[*] Save system has been optimized
[*] The Bell lever now correctly appears in its previous place after the cutscene with the falling bell after loading the last save
[*] Trees got their shiny branches back instead of black lines
[/list]
[h3]DLCs:[/h3]
[b]Late Fees (Library):[/b]
[list]
[*] Quentin no longer gets stuck at the corner of the staircase after falling from the top
[*] The lever in the basement now functions properly if player selects 'Load Last Save' immediately after interacting with the lever
[*] Addressed the magical respawn of books on selecting 'Load Last Save' after placing them on the appropriate shelf
[*] The book trolley is back!
[*] Spade book no longer respawns on the fountain and can be picked up even after getting caught by the librarian
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215322/Hello_Neighbor_2_Late_Fees_DLC/

[b]Back to school:[/b]
[list]
[*] Helped the janitor escape a sticky situation – he can no longer get stuck in a railing collision on the second floor
[*] Put a stop to the application crashing when you navigate towards the clock mechanism room
[*] After leaving the drone outside the school and hitting the button in the 'Principal' room to unlock the 'Dungeon' area, the drone no longer explores ‘out of the world’ dimensions
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215321/Hello_Neighbor_2_Back_to_School_DLC/

[b]Hello-copter:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fly on, little buddy: fixed the drone functionality hiccup after loading the last save post-drone flight
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215320/Hello_Neighbor_2_Hellocopter_DLC/

notes.title: Halloween Update Out Now - Raven Brooks Forest now open to the public!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch #9 has finally arrived![/h1]

Between the looming trees, crumbling wooden structures, long abandoned railway and derelict church, an ominous figure seems to lurk, waiting for anyone unfortunate enough to venture into the dark forest of Raven Brooks. The mystery continues, and secrets are waiting to be uncovered…

Pack your tools, your camera and a jacket, because this sounds like a job for Quentin!

Check out the trailer below!

 [previewyoutube=Za-RMMA5GgA;full][/previewyoutube]

[quote][b]Welcome to the forests of Raven Brooks[/b], where you can step away from the hustle and bustle of town life, angry neighbors, questionable architectural practices, and people that take exception to you intruding on their property and just bask in tranquility and solitude.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/f470fa31a0d7830c6f31f3cf2424ed992b1f386a.png[/img]

[h2]Raven Brooks Forests[/h2]

There’s nothing more relaxing than a quiet walk in the woods. The crunch of leaves beneath your feet, the soft breeze rippling through the trees, the smell of freshly cut lumber... Don’t let the seemingly impenetrable darkness or sense of being watched put you off though, it’s probably all in your head. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RgBfCS1.gif[/img]

[h2]An Idyllic Church & graveyard[/h2]

Once a renowned landmark and popular destination for townsfolk, the church and adjoining graveyard has found itself in need of a little renovation over recent years. That, alongside some strange noises from the basement and a bell that seems like it would fall at the slightest knock shouldn’t put you off visiting, however.  

[url=https://imgur.com/mI0YQQ0][img]http://i.imgur.com/mI0YQQ0.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]State-of-the-art woodcutting technology[/h2]

While it might not look like much these days, this machinery (which provided much of the wood that built our quaint little town), is more than capable of providing you some high quality planks. Perfect for building platforms or boarding up your doors! It's unlikely you’ll need to do any of that, but those were the first examples that came to mind.

[url=https://imgur.com/haaRBcG][img]http://i.imgur.com/haaRBcG.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Peaceful solitude[/h2]

Naturally, everybody needs an escape sometimes. Something to break up the monotony of running away from people because they found us lurking in their closets or petting their cat. And Raven Brooks Forest offers you just that. Solitude, quiet and time to reflect, maybe even do a little bird watching. 

[i](We must also stress that recent reports of a strange cloaked figure seen lurking throughout the woods are probably completely unfounded.)

[url=https://imgur.com/uChTQdZ][img]http://i.imgur.com/uChTQdZ.gif[/img][/url]

[/i][/quote]

And for any of our Secret Neighbor players lurking around here, we're offering anyone who plays the Hello Neighbor 2 update the much requested Devil Skin! Find out how to redeem it [url=https://gleam.io/NOX4y/play-hello-neighbor-2-and-unlock-the-devil-skin-in-secret-neighbor]HERE[/url] 

Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/neighborgames]Discord[/url] server, we'd love to hear any feedback you might have about the update!

See you in Raven Brooks!

Till next time!

notes.title: Hello Neighbor 2: Patch #8 is live!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hey Hey investigative journalists![/h2][/b]
Grab your stealthy shoes and get ready to sneak into Raven Brooks once again because we’re getting an update for Hello Neighbor 2 today! Patch 8 is here, and it comes with a bag full of new goodies such as improvements to the Neighbor house, art improvements, and pretty animations, upgrades of the controller, and various fixes.

Before jumping into the Update, we want to thank you, our community, for your feedback, which can’t be overestimated. We hear you and appreciate that you share your thoughts with us.

[quote][h3][b]What has been improved[/b][/h3]

[h3] 🔧Mr. Peterson did some house renovation(?)[/h3]

Get ready to explore the updated second floor of Mr. Peterson's house, complete with new hiding spots and sneaky shortcuts that will make it easier to navigate and avoid his watchful eye 👁️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VEWLLvq.gif[/img]

We also recommend checking out this somewhat questionable bed 🛏️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2rsRWmt.gif[/img]

[h3] Get ready to bounce in style ☂️[/h3]

Our art team has prepared new animations for all the trampolines in the game. And those umbrellas in the bakery? Let's say they've gotten a serious makeover.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hMpcxRq.gif[/img]

[h3]Playing for the first time? Upgraded tooltips will come in handy! 📌[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YocX724.gif[/img]

[h3]Get a smoother gaming experience with UX controller update ✨[/h3][/quote]

[b]Full Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Hello Neighbor 2 - Version v1.2.5.5 Update [/b]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Mr. Peterson reorganized the second floor of his house. Check out new hiding spots and sneaky shortcuts
[*] Trampolines got some love in this Update with art and animations upgrades
[*] Tooltips have been updated
[*] The controller has been upgraded
[*] Cop animations are now fixed
[*] The foliage has been optimized 
[*] The map landscape is fixed, and the grass is now fixed, too, no more tripping on uneven terrain!
[/list]

[b]Fixed issues & Other improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cloth materials have been optimized 
[*] NPCs will no longer go outside the residence while looking for Quentin
[*] NPCs now have better vision and can see the player on the table and high surfaces 
[*] Donut box is no longer drowning in the countertop, and there's dough in the Bakery now!
[*] Improved bakery exterior for platforming: more opportunities for parkour and trampoline umbrellas
[*] A paper plane will no longer block your movement
[*] Paint spots are now visible from afar
[*] Paint decals are no longer colorless
[*] Cop is no longer in a permanent state of surprise on the porch, he’s not ghosts, after all!
[*] The ball under the treehouse is now passable
[*] You won't get stuck jumping on street lamps anymore in 'Back to School' and 'Late Fees' DLC 
[*] LODs on the box on the roof of the Taxidermist's house are fixed
[*] Textures of the fences are now fixed
[*] The collision on the boulder in front of Quentin's office is now present
[*] No more climbing on curtains and getting stuck there 
[*] The drone is no longer stuck after flying near any storage item, you can explore the game freely!
[*] The landscape has been fixed
[*] The painting material is fixed
[*] Office stairs and terrace material is now fixed
[*] Mayor’s outside decor is now solid
[*] The camera monitor will no longer work after Quentin falls from the height
[*] You’re now redirected to the correct place after selecting 'Load the last save' in the pause menu 
[*] The black corrupted texture on the stairs in 'Back to School' DLC is fixed
[*] NPCs won't slide momentarily when you get detected from behind while they're playing search or hear animation
[*] A bug that could cause the drone to become uncontrollable has been fixed
[*] Cop no longer gets stuck
[*] Librarian now has the sound of steps
[*] Invert x/y setting works properly on cameras and drone
[*] Hideout's book now has appropriate material
[*] The sound of windows opening and closing is now fixed 
[*] The sounds of inserting the button in the player are now clear 
[*] Entering a closet now matches the sound with the action
[*] Quest items now make a sound when you pick them up, not like a silent movie
[*] Music and ambient are back in the cut scene in the Taxidermist's house 
[*] Animations and sound effects have been updated in Patch 8
[*] A lamp in school no longer vanishes after loading savings 
[*] Drones can no longer pull levers using the drone hook like a magic trick in 'Late Fees' DLC
[*] Items are now hidden when the player climbs
[*] Toy rails are now optimized
[*] The game no longer crashes after using a drone in a free chapter, unless you're really bad at piloting it
[*] You can no longer use the camera display while on the loading screen
[*] Streetlights now light up during the free chapter
[*] The Neighbor now turns with proper animation
[*] The game no longer crashes while navigating to the kitchen after completing the piano puzzle, unless you're too excited for dinner
[*] Using color spray no longer results in white visual artifacts unless you're a big fan of abstract art
[*] The game no longer crashes when AI is trying to catch Quentin in the closet
[*] Cliff in front of the Hideout now has an appropriate collision 
[/list]

Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/neighborgames]Discord[/url] server! We've recently updated our forums to make submitting feedback easier than ever! 

See you in Raven Brooks!

Till next time!

notes.title: Hello Neighbor 2: Patch #3 is live
notes.content:
Hello, Neighbors!

Our team continues to work hard to improve the game with each update. Thank you very much for the feedback you share with us. It helps us a lot, and we greatly appreciate it.

Today's update to Hello Neighbor 2 brings a lot of improvements to UX and AI, animations, visuals, VFX enhancements, revamped inventory, bug fixes to the main game and DLCs, and much more! 

If you encounter any issues in the game, please let us know on our [url=http://discord.gg/neighborgames]Discord server[/url] or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1321680/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url].

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2: Patch #3 Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]AI Capture feature improvements[/h3]
The AI capture feature has been improved and has become even more... frightening!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D8QHB2S.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] We've updated the existing animations and added some new player capture animations for the characters.
[*] The capture feature has become "smarter" under the hood - you’re no longer safe in a much wider variety of situations.
[/list][h3]Inventory[/h3]
The inventory UI has been reworked and improved.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TlAkhNk.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Items will now correctly face players in the inventory.
[*] Navigation has been significantly improved, making it more intuitive and clear.
[/list][h3]Art & Animation[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OhncTDm.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Many new visual effects have been added in different locations. The game world now feels even more alive!
[*] A lot of props, textures, and animations have been enhanced for both the main game and the DLC.
[*] Added a few minor cutscenes and animations.
[*] We've patched a few potholes in the roads and fixed some fences here and there.
[*] Lighting in houses and outdoors has been enhanced.
[*] A lot of sound effects have been added and enhanced.
[/list][h3]Quentin's office renovation[/h3]
Quentin's office has been significantly improved and refined. You can now find many more exciting details and décor elements in there!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7oGaXnd.gif[/img]

[h3]Game tutorial[/h3]
The tutorial puzzle has been redesigned to make the introduction to the basics of the game more coherent and informative.

[h3]Player navigation[/h3] 
We have improved the pathways for players to make it easier to navigate and explore Ravenbrooks.

[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gamepad controls have been improved
[*] You can adjust the gamepad layout by selecting from a few control presets that better suit your preferences.

[*] [b][DLC][/b] Books in the library will no longer float in the air.
[*] [b][DLC][/b] The school will no longer have a white square on the ceiling.
[*] [b][DLC][/b] Fixed a bug that could prevent a drone from appearing in free-to-play after a boss fight.
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent players from being notified about overwriting the save file when creating a new game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the slider in the sound settings did not match the cursor speed.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the Mayor to get stuck in the gramophone texture when trying to turn it off.
[*] The board in the Barn is no longer "hanging" in the air.
[*] Players will no longer be able to climb out of the cage during a boss fight.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Aaron to be placed in the incorrect location during the final cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue where the time would not change in the cutscene with the newspaper in the basement of the Neighbor's house.
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent some objects from loading in the arrival cutscene.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause table models to be missing from the awakening cutscene in the office.
[*] The car's wheels will no longer protrude through the walls in the 'arrival' scene in Barn.
[*] Fixed a bug that could have caused a cap to be visible on Quentin's head under the bandage.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause some players to get stuck by a boulder model at the riverbed.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause players to get stuck on the veranda at the Taxidermist's if they tried to climb the cupboard.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the sound of the attic door opening from playing.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the sound of the metal door opening in the attic from playing.

notes.title: The Hello Neighbor 2 Beta just got it's first update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/16510cb0a22ee96cbbc6ba5287d1abe0534e4360.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Hello, Neighbors![/b][/h2]

The Hello Neighbor 2 Beta has just received an update! This 1.1 update is mostly technical and live now if you can't wait to jump in and test it out. But if you wanna check out the patch notes first you'll find them down below! And for anyone just tuning in and asking [i]"What Beta?"[/i], we've got you covered there too, so keep reading! 

So First things first, what can you look forward to in the Beta and how do you get your mitts on it? Let’s get into it. You may have noticed there are two editions currently available for pre-order. The Hello Neighbor 2 Standard Edition pre-order will contain the full game on launch + instant Beta access once your pre-order is completed. While both versions will grant you Beta access the Deluxe Edition comes with a few pretty sweet extras. Namely, 3 brand new DLC available on launch, and 5 days of Early Access to the game prior to its full release on December 6th, 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/05a2b271b81c5afd99eabf829b851441070f8954.png[/img]

The Beta itself is what we like to call the [i]Encapsulated Hello Neighbor 2 Beta Experience[/i]. While Hello Neighbor 2 is still in development, we're excited to bring you a slice of how the final game will look and feel with many of its new locations, residents, and visuals. Certain gameplay elements such as breakable windows and boxes will be waiting for you in the full release. And did we mention the Beta is spoiler-free? We’re saving all of the biggest secrets for launch day so feel free to dive right in! 

Now before we get to informational bits we are going to take a moment to shamelessly plug our new Hello Neighbor 2 merch because it's really cool and our artist worked really hard on it. 
[url=https://shop.tinybuild.com/products/imbir-cat-plush][b]Bring home a piece of Hello Neighbor 2 with our brand new Imbir plush![/b][/url] 
Lovingly designed by HN2's Lead Artist Elena, you can be sure every inch of this plush is extra huggable right down to the embroidered toe beans, adopt yours today!

We also dropped a whole batch of limited edition [url=https://shop.tinybuild.com/products/8-pin-set][b]Hello Neighbor 2 enamel pins[/b][/url]! You can snag your favorite character,  or grab the whole set! You can find all our new merch in [url=https://shop.tinybuild.com/][b]the tinyBuild Shop[/b][/url] now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/259b9aa0179031c42f651dd73ffa4cf64879da07.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello Neighbor 2 Beta Version 1.1 Patch Notes[/b][/h3]

[u][b]Fixed Issues:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The baker properly gets rid of items inside the residence in a timely manner
[*] The baker also places key in cabinet once & places it correctly from inside
[*] Cutscene fixes - including turning Quentin to face the correct direction
[*] Overall fixes to UI, button callouts, and interact icon prompts on all platforms
[*] Missing poster does not clip through the tree & is visible nailed to the trunk
[*] Lightpoles light up correctly and point correct direction during the cutscene
[*] Day/night cycle smoothed out - take a break and admire the sunset! 🌇
[*] Quentin no longer gets stuck on ladder while accessing pause menu
[*] All quests now display on pinboard as you progress through quests
[*] Camera mounting on corner surfaces and horizontal controls fixed
[*] Mayor no longer gets stuck in the cycle of opening & closing doors
[*] Bug fixes + various under the hood improvements & optimizations
[*] When language is changed to Japanese text no longer flickers
[*] The taxidermist's materials now lie correctly on work table
[*] Taxidermist recipe paper now loads correctly on save reload
[*] All wood textured keyholes corrected to have metal texture
[*] Quests no longer disappear from pinboard on game restart
[*] Jumping on stairs in barn no longer breaks controls
[*] Quentin's watch (notifications) and locational triggers corrected
[*] When using the bed audio now plays correctly
[*] Some save, settings, and menu function fixes
[*] Door loading and operation fixes throughout
[*] Guest should now catch Quentin as intended
[*] Items no longer float when placed in trash
[*] Passage of time now triggers appropriately
[*] Officer Keith no longer gets stuck outside
[*] Quentin should now hold items correctly
[*] Quentin can no longer get stuck in barn
[*] Light hue and brightness corrections
[*] Various texture fixes throughout
[*] Camera sensitivity fixes
[*] Freeze and crash fixes
[*] Collision fixes
[/list]
[u][b]What's changed:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Final cutscene can no longer be triggered by climbing through window - sorry speed runners
[*] Heavy door in Neighbor's House can now be opened from one side only
[*] You can no longer activate the siren from outside the closed window (police car)
[*] If you actually read this far leave the word potato in the comments
[*] You can no longer observe AI with camera if they are too far away
[*] Tv station window can no longer be entered from either direction
[*] You are prompted to save your changes upon exiting the menu
[*] Boards can no longer be taken from their respective locations
[*] Camera sensitivity is now increased by default on PC
[*] Boards can no longer be torn off from the back side
[*] Door on 2nd floor of Peterson house is now blocked
[*] Inventory is now locked while climbing ladders
[/list]
Before we sign off we just want to thank our amazing community for all of your fantastic feedback, bug reports, and playthroughs! They are absolutely invaluable to us as a team and help us to build a better game that everyone can enjoy, so please keep it coming! 

Cheers,
tinyFox, tinyBuild & Eerie Guest Studios

notes.title: The Hello Neighbor Showcase!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2]

We’ve just wrapped up [b]The Hello Neighbor Showcase,[/b] our online direct event outlining the many new and exciting updates to come throughout the Hello Neighbor Franchise. In case you missed the event let’s go over what you can look forward to in the coming months!

[previewyoutube=QIkqToWd6ZE;full][previewyoutube=c8iml-S-DsA;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Secret Neighbor is sneaking onto a platform near you![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/axUpY6Q.gif[/img]

It’s been hard to keep this secret locked up but it’s escaped the basement and finally, we can share it. 

We’re excited to announce that [b]Secret Neighbor will be coming to PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and iOS![/b] Pre orders for Secret Neighbor on PlayStation will open on March 30th. The full game release for PlayStation and iOS will be April 29th, and release plans for Secret Neighbor on Switch will be announced later this Summer. Another important update, our PlayStation and iOS versions will be cross-play compatible!

In addition to this, we are working hard to provide all platforms a parity of content and synchronized updates in the future and will keep you updated on our progression towards this goal. Our 2021 Secret Neighbor Development Roadmap will also be on its way to you in the coming weeks, so keep a sharp eye out for even more updates very soon!

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2 - The AI takeover[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4muhXH5.gif[/img]

Hello Neighbor 2 is nearing its crucial development stage and we are working hard on Alpha 2. There have been some big updates to the AI. Mr. Peterson is now even more capable of learning from previous player behavior in order to plan new ways to thwart you from learning his dark secrets. 

But not just Mr. Peterson, every character you encounter in Hello Neighbor 2 will share the same AI core...though their motivations and stories may differ. 

[h2]Hello Engineer - Full steam ahead[/h2]

Hello Engineer Beta Testing is currently in progress and we will be sharing more exciting news on its development soon. In the meantime, check out some fun gifs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sWhIcP1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AyeyTuO.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s04gvuM.gif[/img]

[h2]The Guest is back and he’s...huggable?[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R9oyC4q.gif[/img]

In partnership with our friends at Snap Creative, we are very excited to bring you The Guest Musical Plush! 

He is poseable, with wired limbs and a swivel head. And he has not one but two music boxes! Press his belly to play music, or press his bag for a surprise! 

He is made from soft cotton fabrics and approximately 10.5” tall. Pre-orders are now open and the estimated delivery of this cuddly menace is September 2021. 

[b]Pre-Order your own Guest now![/b]
https://shophelloneighbor.com/

[h2]Hello Neighbor is getting some TLC[/h2]

And last but not least, over the past few months we’ve been working behind the scenes to update and improve Hello Neighbor mobile version performance and gameplay and will continue to make some additional updates moving forward.

Thank you for checking out The Hello Neighbor Showcase!

Catch you later!
tinyFox, tinyBuild & the HoloGryph team

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Work In Progress
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LzGkya7.gif[/img]

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 is not that far away. Can you guess when is it coming by looking at these gifs? :)

Meanwhile, we wanted to share with you what we've been working on for this update. As you could tell from the Alpha name, the game will not be drastically different from the Alpha 1. Instead, we've focused our attention inwards: for the past couple of months, we've been busy improving the gameplay.

[h2]The Survey[/h2]

As a part of this inward focus, we'd like to hear more from you, our players. The purpose of the last survey was to get to know you better. With this one, we're looking to get your feedback on the gameplay of HN2 Alpha 1, which will help us make adjustments to the future Alphas.

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/HN2A1gameplay]Here's the link[/url]. Huge thanks for participating!!


Without showing all the cards, here's a brief outline of what we've been working on:

[h2]The Changes[/h2]

[i][list]
[*] Reworked the main house: added more interactions and interesting opportunities for a player to traverse the house
[*] Reworked the AI - the Guest's behavior is now more complex, with a more coherent cycle (schedule) 
[*] Improved open world - we've heard you loud and clear - it's nice to have an open world, but there's got to be a point in exploring it. This is the first iteration of the improved open world, with some cheeky puzzles, and more are to come in the future versions of the game.
[*] More lore! New intro and ending will expand the lore of Hello Neighbor universe. We can't promise that you'd get more answers than questions, though.
[*] Improved mechanics - the rope and the conveyor belt are now implemented as more integral parts of the gameplay
[*] Reworked level design - now it's easier for the new players to get into the game and understand the goal. This rework is aimed at making the game more accessible to new players while remaining mysterious and challenging
[*] Halloween is coming! We're preparing a special Halloween puzzle and other tricks (and treats)
[/list][/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ARNNOz9.gif[/img]

Catch you later!

- 
Eerie Guest & tinyBuild
